API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIPrivileged Credential ManagementMove Privileged credential from one microtenant to another microtenant
Move Privileged credential from one microtenant to another microtenant
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/credential/:id/move

Move Privileged credential from one microtenant to another microtenant

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

id
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the privileged credential.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

targetMicrotenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed.

Responses
​
204
400
401
403
404
405
409
415
500
503

No Content
